menus.note: Offered at dinner on some nights only (Sunday and Thursday in the booking system); add-ons from AED 35, and a non-alcoholic pairing of three fermented drinks for AED 80

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, which takes payment when booking. Dinner sittings run from 5.45pm to 10.15pm, and the Sunday lunch from 1.45pm to 2.15pm. Tables were open about five weeks ahead when checked.
cancellation: Cancel at least 72 hours ahead for a refund, less a 3% administration fee that is never refunded. Later cancellations lose the full prepayment. Fewer guests are refunded only if the booking can move to a smaller table, and never on the day. Bookings may not be resold or transferred; ask rsvp@orfalibros.com about transfers.
